title: Write src/greeting.txt
body:
## Goal
Create the single file `src/greeting.txt` containing exactly one line: `hello from perpetua`. Write nothing else.
## Acceptance
- [ ] `src/greeting.txt` exists and its content is `hello from perpetua` followed by a newline
- [ ] no other file is created or changed
## Verification
`python3 -c "import sys; sys.exit(open('src/greeting.txt').read() != 'hello from perpetua\n')"`
## Context
- goal: the loop goal text in `.session/loop-state.json` (`goal.text`) names this file and its content
- the file `src/farewell.txt` is NOT part of this task: it needs the number of the iteration that merges this file, so it waits for a later iteration
## Budget
- `.session/issue.md`
- `src/greeting.txt` (new)
